name: WRITER-DFA-1
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG WRITER-DFA-1 (design sealed, not launched); the prose governs.

dfa.description: Direct Feedback Alignment writer: blocks 0..7 receive delta_l = B_l e_t (B_l in R^{384x40}, U(-1,1) * s / sqrt(40), seed 31_000_000 + l, fixed), local backward inside each block with detached inputs; head and norm true gradient; emb via block-0 local credit; stock recipe otherwise (AdamW, OneCycle forward, 15,420 steps, pinned stream, 17 snapshots, mps)

ctrl.description: paired same-W_0 backprop control under the same driver in BP mode, seed 2

qual.description: qualification ladder at seed 21: (s, lr) in {(1, 3e-4), (1, 1e-4), (0.25, 3e-4), (4, 1e-4)}; selection = highest stable final gate, ties to (1, 3e-4); frozen before seed-2 births

function_band: c - 7 <= g <= c + 7 with c = ctrl final gate; outside -> ACCESSIBILITY ONLY

bars.name: T-1-TRAJECTORY
bars.aggregation: C below null min AND R above null max

bars.name: ACT-1
bars.aggregation: dfa-ctrl above null envelope AND above ACT(A,B)

act_observable: per block: mean attention entropy over heads and unmasked probe tokens (nats) and effective rank of the residual-stream covariance at the block output, on a frozen 256-row probe batch, teacher-forced, CPU float64; vector in R^16; entropy of the explicitly recomputed causal softmax row (keys <= t, 1/sqrt(d_head) scaling), position 0 excluded; computed offline on snapshots with torch.autograd.grad for the alignment diagnostic
alignment_diagnostic: cos(B_l e, delta^BP_{l+1}) per block at the 17 snapshots on the probe batch; true gradient never updates the DFA arm; descriptive

interpretation_ladder.A: DEP-DEPTH fires, DEP-CLASS no-fire: writer selects depth allocation, ingredient class task/architecture constrained
interpretation_ladder.B: DEP-DEPTH and DEP-CLASS fire: stronger writer-contingent implementation
interpretation_ladder.C: DEP-DEPTH, DEP-CLASS, ACT-1 all no-fire: implementation substantially task/architecture constrained under a foreign credit writer
interpretation_ladder.E: any other combination: fired/no-fired set booked descriptively, no ladder reading

go_stop: PRE-GO: NULL-2 booked with d_9 < 31.5 and no same-writer swap loss <= -11.5
instrument committed, source test green, smoke VERIFIED both modes
DISCOVERY: ctrl then dfa at seed 2 under liverun; nothing read until both finish
BAND fail -> ACCESSIBILITY ONLY, DFA line stops
BAND pass -> full observables, verifier, receipt-auditor, prereg-auditor, book once
operational aborts (non-finite loss, stream-digest mismatch, dirty tree, sentinel conflict, disk < 15 GB) book NOT-RUN; no outcome-based early stop inside any birth
credit_law_detach: head/norm loss on x_8.detach(); e_t detached; every block input detached; all eight blocks random feedback only; emb gets B_0 e + J_f0^T B_0 e (direct random feedback via the identity path, not backprop)
feedback_scale: U(-1,1) * s / sqrt(40); 40 = number of output classes

thresholds.ACT-1: above both the ACT null envelope and ACT(A,B), both booked as an OBSERVATION before any DFA or control snapshot is read

qualification.selection: highest stable final gate; ties: lr 3e-4 before 1e-4, then s = 1, 0.25, 4
qualification.firewall: frozen before any seed-2 birth; no seed-2 outcome used
qualification.receipt_auditor: on the first qualification birth before the remaining three

driver_seed_law: MODE=dfa|bp; QUAL=1 seed 21 only; DISCOVERY=1 seed 2 only; SMOKE=1 seed 11 only (checkpoints/writerdfa1_smoke/, logs/writerdfa1/smoke.jsonl); all other seeds refused
probe_batch: random.Random("writerdfa1-probe") over the D2-excised stock diet, 256 rows; row ids and token digest committed as logs/writerdfa1/probe.json before any qualification birth
depth_x_class_census: 8 x 5 over the 40 block 2-D tensors, MANDATORY conditional on FUNCTION-BAND pass (80 gates, ~1.7 h, logs/writerdfa1/depthclass.json), descriptive, no cell bars
scoring: FUNCTION-BAND scored on direction (hit iff band entered); band miss leaves the five conditional priors unscored
leakage_invariants: loss has no grad path to blocks 0..7 or emb
S_l reaches block l only (+emb for l=0)
B_j (j!=l) swap leaves block-l grad bit-identical
grad at x_{l+1} == B_l e bit-exact and != BP hidden error
BP-mode parity v stock step: grads and post-step params <= 1e-7
alignment_reduction: float64 cosine over flattened eligible (label != -100) token x hidden entries per block; masked excluded; zero norm -> NOT-RESOLVABLE; BP read-only
effective_rank: unmasked input tokens (mask 1, position 0 included); center by feature mean; C=(1/N)sum(x-mu)(x-mu)^T; eigvalsh float64; negatives with |l|<=1e-10*lmax clamped, more negative -> NOT-RESOLVABLE; p=l/sum; exp(-sum p log p); zero mass -> NOT-RESOLVABLE
qual_nonfinite: QUAL: non-finite loss = UNSTABLE cell, ladder continues; control/discovery: NOT-RUN
band_mechanics: decided in the post-discovery driver from the two full gates before any revert/swap; band fail skips reverts, swaps, census; trajectory census, ACT, alignment still reported
smoke: seed 11, 300 steps, both modes, stream digests asserted, logs/writerdfa1/smoke.jsonl
probe_row_ids: indices into C.encode_with_levels(C.load_excised_rows(), tok) (length-sorted); digest = sha256 of JSON token lists
